item.title: Norway fines Microsoft ad firm $9.6 million over Grindr data sharing
item.dc:creator: Bill Toulas
item.description: Norway's Data Protection Authority (Datatilsynet) has fined Microsoft-owned advertising company Xandr NOK 92 million ($9.6M) for unlawfully processing and sharing sensitive data belonging to Grindr users in the country. [...]

item.title: Yandex confirms service outage as users lose access to cloud files
item.dc:creator: Bill Toulas
item.description: Russian cloud services provider Yandex announced that drone attacks damaged three of its data centers, forcing it to shut down two facilities and partially disable a third. [...]

item.title: Anthropic takes risky AI tests offline after models breach govt sites
item.dc:creator: Bill Toulas
item.description: Anthropic announced that its internal AI models undergoing "high-risk and cybersecurity evaluations" no longer have internet access following incidents involving U.S. government websites at the federal, state, and local levels. [...]

item.title: Ledger confirms spy chip implant behind wallet crypto thefts
item.dc:creator: Bill Toulas
item.description: Ledger has confirmed that some of its devices distributed through Southeast Asian reseller CryptoBilis were compromised with a hardware implant that drained users' cryptocurrency wallets. [...]

item.title: Cyberattack shuts down refrigerators at French supermarkets
item.dc:creator: Sergiu Gatlan
item.description: Attackers remotely defrosted refrigerators at multiple French supermarket chains overnight in a cyberattack that reportedly targeted Danfoss refrigeration controllers. [...]

item.title: Inside AvisLoader: A Windows Malware Loader Built to Resist Disruption
item.dc:creator: Sponsored by Varonis
item.description: A new Windows malware loader called AvisLoader uses encrypted peer-to-peer communications to make command-and-control infrastructure harder to disrupt. Varonis researchers explain how the malware uses ClickFix delivery, shortcut-based persistence, and remote command execution capabilities. [...]
